notes: Encoded ONLY from Lear Siegler's own page text (last manufactured 1986, per page). The page lists sister/similar brands (AirBloc, Ambirad, Benson, Broan, Frigidaire, Gibson, Intertherm, Kelvinator, Nordyne, Reznor, Westinghouse, etc.), but per the Benson precedent a shared listing does not by itself establish a shared serial system, so no sisters are claimed and no usesStylesOf is set; the rules below are transcribed from this page's own sections, not imported from the Nordyne page, even though the text matches the Nordyne-family system. Counting convention follows the Wave 3 Nordyne lesson: the page states positions as 'numerical digits', but digit-only counting is falsified by the page's own examples (style 1 digit-only gives month 82, invalid; style 2 digit-only gives 1991, contradicting the coordinator-verified 1989 character-counting reading), so character counting governs throughout and every example decodes under it. Page styles 3, 4 and 5 (the second style numbered 4 on the page) are merged into one shipped style: after normalization all three have the identical shape letter-digit-letter + 9 digits and identical year/month positions, so they are one system, not three colliding styles (same treatment as Benson).

styles.notes: Page positions 4th & 5th = year, 6th & 7th = month (1-based characters), converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7]. Character counting: '03' -> 2003, '07' -> July. Digit-only counting is falsified here (4th & 5th numerical digits '70', 6th & 7th '82', invalid month).

Page example shown as 'F3891 4228' (space stripped by normalization). Page positions 3rd & 4th = year (1-based characters), converted to [2,4] -> '89' -> 1989. This is the Wave 3 coordinator-corrected Nordyne Style 2 reading: character counting ships 1989; digit-only counting (1991) is falsified by the family's own examples. No month is stated for this style, so it ships year-only.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter-digit-letter + 9 digits (page styles 3, 4 and 5 merged)
styles.notes: Page style 3 example 'G6R9905-05028', page style 4 example 'M 1 G 9807 - 05432', page style 5 (misnumbered as a second style 4 on the page) example 'E2E-9705 01234'; all normalize to letter-digit-letter + 9 digits with year at normalized positions [3,5] and month at [5,7]. Page-stated positions differ by raw counting (dashes/spaces included) but coincide after normalization, which is why the three page styles collapse to this single style. Disjoint from style-1 (2nd character is a digit here, a letter there).
